subcategory_text: The data processing environment is identified (e.g., geographic location, internal, cloud, third parties).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CM-8(6) (Inventory of Personally Identifiable Information Components)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.9 (Inventory of information assets)
GDPR Art. 27 (Representatives of controllers/processors not established in the Union)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.AM-09 (data location inventory)
implementation_examples: Identify the geographic location and hosting environment (on-premises, cloud, third-party) for each personal-data processing activity
Record whether the location triggers cross-border data transfer requirements (e.g., adequacy, SCCs, BCRs)
Track the responsible jurisdiction and the supervisory authority for each processing location
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the processing environment (location, hosting model) is identified per inventory item
Determine whether cross-border transfer mechanisms are recorded
Determine whether jurisdictions and supervisory authorities are mapped
Determine whether location changes trigger privacy-impact re-assessment
